name: Chucky's Huge Ring
summary: At the Ruins of Aboraz, Chucky “Ten Thumbs” has a ring that Sea Wolf MacKinley wants. It is one of three valuables sought for debts left unpaid.

sections.title: A Debt in the Jungle
sections.body: MacKinley’s list leads you to Chucky “Ten Thumbs” among the jungle ruins of Stranglethorn Vale. The pirate says Chucky and two other debtors vanished after their debts went unpaid. He wants their valuables gathered, and Chucky’s huge ring is one of them.

faq.answer: Chucky “Ten Thumbs” is a debtor sought by Sea Wolf MacKinley. He wanders the Ruins of Aboraz in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Where can I find Chucky's ring?
faq.answer: Chucky’s Huge Ring is at the Ruins of Aboraz in Stranglethorn Vale, where Chucky “Ten Thumbs” wanders.

faq.q: Why does MacKinley want the ring?
faq.answer: MacKinley wants valuables from three debtors whose payments are months overdue. Chucky’s ring is one of the items he asks you to bring to Booty Bay.

faq.q: What is Chucky's Huge Ring for?
faq.answer: The ring is one of three valuables Sea Wolf MacKinley requests for the debts owed by Chucky and two other pirates.
